findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_price_barometer, get_guided_massage, get_practitioner_slots, get_practice_city_facts, get_practitioner_reviews, check_presentation_text · Public sink: book_slot, add_sms_reminder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_price_barometer, get_guided_massage, get_practitioner_slots, get_practice_city_facts, get_practitioner_reviews, check_presentation_text · Public sink: book_slot, add_sms_reminder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
